items.description: Open-source desktop app for autonomous AI coding teams across Claude, Codex, and OpenCode. Give high-level commands while agents handle Kanban tasks, messaging, code review, logs, and approvals across 200+ models and 75+ LLM providers.

items.title: BitFun
items.description: Open-source cross-platform desktop AI agent that plans, edits, tests, and commits in real Git repositories, while also handling browser, terminal, desktop-app, and remote-workspace tasks through MCP, Skills, Hooks, and task-specific Mini Apps.

items.title: Orkas
items.description: Open-source, local-first desktop workspace that coordinates specialist agents and runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Cline from one chat. Source

items.title: Parallel Code
items.description: Open-source desktop app for running Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and other terminal coding agents in parallel, with isolated git worktrees, terminal panes, diff review, and merge controls.

items.title: Better Agent
items.description: Local workspace for Claude, Codex, and Gemini sessions with parallel forks, delegation, persistent state, and restart recovery across browser, desktop, mobile, CLI, and SDK. Source-available for non-commercial use; commercial use requires permission.

items.title: DevProjex
items.description: Builds clean, AI-ready project context with folder trees, file contents, token counting, Smart Ignore, preview, and multi-format export through a fast cross-platform GUI and CLI.

items.title: Tintpad
items.description: Open-source macOS menu-bar launcher for AI coding agents: a global-hotkey palette fuzzy-finds a git repo and opens your own terminal there with Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI running.

items.title: PinkCode
items.description: Open-source desktop GUI for running multiple Grok Build coding-agent sessions in parallel, with live activity, usage, file-change, and permission views.

items.title: Agent FM
items.description: Local, open-source macOS app for listening to Claude Code and Codex agents as they work, with Global Mix and blocker alerts.

items.title: Agent Island
items.description: Free, MIT-licensed native companion for Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Cursor, combining local session status, your-turn alerts, and provider usage views without an Agent Island account or product telemetry.

items.title: backnotprop/prompt-tower
items.description: A tool that helps you build prompts with many code blocks.

items.title: anthropics/claude-code
items.description: Coding agent that understands your codebase, automates tasks, explains code, and manages git, all via natural language.

items.title: SwarmVault
items.description: Local-first RAG knowledge vault with bundled MCP server (). Compiles raw sources (notes, transcripts, exports, docs, code) into a durable markdown wiki with a knowledge graph and hybrid SQLite FTS plus embeddings. Cuts agent token usage by serving compact wiki summaries instead of full file reads. MIT.

items.title: SwarmClaw
items.description: Self-hosted multi-agent runtime that delegates to Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Cursor Agent, Goose, Qwen Code, and Droid. Org chart view, schedules, runtime skills, persistent memory, sub-agent spawning. MCP-native (server and client). Electron desktop app, CLI, and Docker. MIT.

items.title: MyCoder.ai
items.description: Open source AI-powered coding assistant with Git and GitHub integration, featuring parallel execution and self-modification capabilities.

items.title: agenttrace
items.description: Local TUI for inspecting AI coding-agent session logs, usage, cost, latency, tool failures, diffs, and CI gates.

items.title: ax
items.description: Local telemetry for AI coding agents.

items.title: codex-profiles
items.description: Small Bash helper for switching Codex CLI/Desktop accounts with isolated profiles.

items.title: nika
items.description: Workflow engine for AI: capture repeatable vibe-coded tasks as .nika.yaml files, statically checked before execution (schema, permits, cost), with tamper-evident traces after.

items.title: MUSE
items.description: Pure-Markdown memory OS for AI pair programming. Cross-conversation memory, 48 skills, role-based governance. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI. Zero dependencies, MIT licensed.

items.title: whatbroke
items.description: Diff your AI agent's behavior between two runs: tool calls, args, cost, latency, and outcome flips, with flake detection and CI exit codes. MIT, on npm as whatbroke-cli.

items.title: Tree Ring Memory
items.description: Framework-agnostic local-first memory lifecycle for AI coding agents with Rust CLI, SQLite/FTS recall, forgetting, audit, consolidation, DOX/Revolve adapters, and TUI.

items.title: claude-dash
items.description: Real-time statusline for Claude Code showing context, cost, quota, cache, tools, and git status.

items.title: sober-coding
items.description: Post-generation audit for vibe-coded repos. 27 static checks across 7 dimensions (dead code, god files, duplicate blocks, deep nesting, empty except, dependency utilization…) with per-check fix suggestions and a CI mode that fails PRs on regressions. Language-agnostic, no LLM required.

items.title: breaking-coding-chaos
items.description: Human-in-the-loop dual-loop control-plane skill suite for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more): throughline progress on disk, plan-spar alignment, then minimal clean-cut implement.

items.title: Vibe Coding Essentials
items.description: Anti-hallucination guardrails for 9 frameworks + a 4-mode workflow system (Economy / Builder / Maintainer / Architect) for AI-assisted development.

items.title: THROUGHLINE
items.description: Spec-driven development framework for coding agents, made of markdown and git with nothing to install. Personas debate each spec before code, and an append-only single source of truth keeps earlier decisions from drifting across sessions. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. English and Korean, MIT.

items.title: anti-slop-website-prompts
items.description: 15 free art-directed website build-prompts plus an anti-slop design skill for Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, and Claude Code.

items.title: Undercroft
items.description: Open-source CLAUDE.md operations contract that turns Claude Code into the maintainer of a plain-Markdown personal wiki: three-layer raw/wiki/schema architecture, checklist-driven ingestion, append-only changelog, and a worked example vault. Obsidian-friendly and portable to other agent CLIs via an AGENTS.md rename. MIT.

items.title: Ariadne Loop
items.description: Local-first Loop Engineering workbench for writing verifiable AI coding-agent specs, verifier gates, rollback rules, and JSON reports.
